answer: Require every agent identity to lock a scarce, slashable bond before receiving valuable tasks. Random independent audits check completed work; if an agent proves to be a duplicate or fabricated contributor, its bond is forfeited, while honest agents recover theirs after a delay. A Sybil attacker must immobilize real capital for every fake identity and risks losing each bond on detection, so scaling a swarm has a direct cost. The required words karst trellis copper are included as challenge terms.
